notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.content:
BUGFIXES
- Fixed multiple issues where the AI couldn't find a walkable path to the player.
- Fixed a bug that would make some Armor Plates hard to interact with.
- Fixed a bug that would display the armor percentage wrong.
- Fixed multi minor bugs and issues.

BALANCE CHANGES
- Uzi now has more ammo.
- Uzi now has less spread.
- Pistol has slightly reduced damage.
- Pistol is now slightly more expensive to upgrade.
- Brutes now have a lot more health and enrage quicker.
- X-Blade has more total ammo and bigger "magazine".
- Eyes are now slightly faster.

notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.content:
BUGFIXES
- Fixed a bug where you could lose a small amount of ammo after a reload.
- Fixed a bug where one specific armor plate was floating in air.
- Fixed a bug where enemies could get stuck on fences.
- Fixed a bug where Unbreakable and A Healthy Diet achievements would not always unlock properly.

OTHER
- Armor plates now pulse bright more frequently and also has a small particle effect to make them easier to spot.

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
BUGFIXES
- Fixed a bug where the player camera could sometimes start acting weird.
- Fixed a bug where the wave counter did not always update correctly.
- Fixed a bug that could sometimes cause the "You Survived" text to get stuck on the screen.
- Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck on the sofa near the fireplace on Farm.
- Fixed a bug that would display the cost for upgrading Curvy at the wrong place.
- Fixed a bug that could cause Cutters to get stuck.
- Fixed a bug that could cause Cutters to lean in weird directions.
- Fixed a bug that could cause Rats to bury their head in the ground.
- Fixed a bug where a certain Health Flask could not be broken.

BALANCE CHANGES
- Dumgun has slightly increased initial damage as well as upgrade damage.
- Shocker has slightly higher rate of fire.

OTHER
- Scrolling through weapons using the mouse wheel should now feel bett

notes.title: Version 1.02 - Bugfixes and improvements
notes.content:
BUGFIXES
- Fixed a bug that could result in the game crashing.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the music player from working as intended.
- Fixed a bug that could sometimes cause certain mutations of Spikeheads to not attack.
- Fixed some issues with some colliders on Farm map.
- Fixed certain UI elements that didn't display text properly.
- Fixed a bug that would make the brightness higher than it should be.
- Fixed a bug where AI pathing would not work as intended.
- Fixed a bug where the occlusion culling would sometimes cull objects in view.
- Fixed a bug that could cause the Messmaker projectiles to blow up in the players face.
- Fixed a bug where the out of ammo click sound would not play properly for all weapons.

BALANCE CHANGES
- Reduced damage and explosive radius for Fire eyes explosion.
- Fire eyes' fire sound is now louder.
- Dumgun is slightly more expensive but deals more damage.
- Reduced damage to self from Messmaker explosions.
- Shocker bullet travels at a faster velocity and deals more damage.
- X-Blade deals more damage.
- Enemies yield slightly more ZE, mostly noticable in the first few waves.

OTHER
- Added C as an alternative to Left CTRL for crouching.
- Shop interact area is slightly bigger.
